keywords: Importance of natural environment and open spaces
Planning and design of parks and open spaces
educationalGoal: Urbanization and development have often caused pollution and disasters, and have affected people's health. The planning and design for the local and urban environments have been developed while solving these social problems. In this course, students will learn the basic concept for discussing the environment, such as environmental capacity and biodiversity, as well as the planning and design based on these items, and acquire the knowledge for urban and regional planning.
advice:
In this study, we will learn the basic concepts of open space planning and ecological planning, and discuss methods to conserve and utilize them in sustainable community development.

We will cover the following materials:
1) The multifunctionality of green spaces and the concept of its utilization
2) Planning and design of park and open spaces and recent developments
3) Evaluation and conservation of ecosystems and regional planning
4) Concept and planning method of green infrastructure
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of law and standard concerning land-use planning

5.Regional cooperation

              Urbanization and development have often caused pollution and disasters, and have affected people's health. The planning and design for the local and urban environments have been developed while solving these social problems. In this course, students will learn the basic concept for discussing the environment, such as environmental capacity and biodiversity, as well as the planning and design based on these items, and acquire the knowledge for urban and regional planning.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this study, we will learn the basic concepts of open space planning and ecological planning, and discuss methods to conserve and utilize them in sustainable community development.

We will cover the following materials:
1) The multifunctionality of green spaces and the concept of its utilization
2) Planning and design of park and open spaces and recent developments
3) Evaluation and conservation of ecosystems and regional planning
4) Concept and planning method of green infrastructure
